source_utterance: Every month, copy last month's totals from the Sales tab to the Archive tab so I stop doing it by hand.
intent: On the first of each month, append the Sales tab's totals range to the Archive tab with a month key. Nothing leaves the sheet.
trigger: time-driven, monthly on the 1st; time zone confirmed with the owner as the sheet's (Europe/London); the run may start later in the day
input: Sales tab, range A1:F40 of the one sheet

predicate.not_applicable: copies the whole fixed range every time, so there is no per-row eligibility rule

transformation: none: values are copied as they are, plus a month key and a timestamp
destination: Archive tab of the same sheet
permissions: this one spreadsheet only (a script bound to the sheet)
idempotency: the month key (YYYY-MM) is written beside the rows; skip if that key is already in the Archive tab
failure_policy: stop and email the owner if the Sales range is empty or its headers changed; never write a partial set of rows

audit_log.not_applicable: the appended rows carry their own month key and timestamp, and nothing is sent outside the sheet

data_retention.not_applicable: no personal data; the archive lives as long as the sheet

quota.not_applicable: one append of about 40 rows a month, far below any documented limit

success_measure: after each run the Archive tab has exactly one block for the new month with the same row count as the Sales range
rollback: delete the Archive rows with that month key

decisions.choice: Apps Script on a monthly trigger
decisions.reason: a formula cannot append history, and one scheduled copy does not justify a separate service

decisions.choice: no eligibility rule, audit log, retention or quota section
decisions.reason: data never leaves the sheet and the volume is tiny
